'''Sleeping Doom''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Esh-kha]] who was imprisoned on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] thousands of years before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He resided within the [[Ancient Prison Caverns|Deep Prison]] when he along with his kind were accidentally freed by the attack of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on [[the Tomb]]. This led to the Esh-kha attacking both the forces of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Invasion of Belsavis|Battle of Belsavis]] Sleeping Doom resided within the area known as the [[Passage to the Scar]], where he was cornered and killed.
